prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need (brand strategy, creative advertising, digital performance, B2B lead gen, SEO, social, etc.).

To help you find the best match, tell me:
- What specific services do you need? (branding, ad campaigns, paid media, SEO, content, social, email, PR, B2B lead gen, etc.)
- Your budget (monthly retainer or project budget)
- Your company type/size and industry (B2B or B2C, local or national)
- Timeline and desired outcomes (awareness, sales, leads, app installs, etc.)

If you want to search on your own first, check:
- Clutch.co and UpCity for client reviews and categories
- Ad Age and local business awards for recognized firms
- Google/LinkedIn for case studies and team bios

Examples of the kinds of agencies you might consider (to illustrate fit, not a definitive ranking):
- Large full-service/creative agencies — good for big national campaigns and creative strategy.
- Global/digital agencies — strong for integrated digital product and platform work.
- Boutiques/specialists — often better for tight budgets, fast execution, or niche skills (SEO, performance marketing, B2B lead gen).

If you want, I can: 
- Give a short list of Kansas City agencies matched to your needs (based on the details above), or
- Pull top-rated KC agencies from directories and summarize their strengths and pricing ranges.

Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
